name: explainer-video
description: Make 3Blue1Brown-style explainer videos: Manim animations on black with CMU Serif text, narrated with ElevenLabs text-to-speech, from a topic to a checked 1080p60 MP4 with the audio synced, transcribed and checked for clicks and gaps.

interface.longDescription: Plans the narration, voices it with ElevenLabs, animates it in Manim with the 3Blue1Brown look and builds one 1080p60 MP4. Every clip is trimmed, transcribed and checked, the soundtrack is assembled from the clips and checked against the picture, and every frame is reviewed on contact sheets before the report.
defaultPrompt: Use $explainer-video to make a 5-minute 3b1b-style video on how RAG works.
Use $explainer-video to make a short narrated explainer about bloom filters.
Use $explainer-video to fix the click at 1:31 in my explainer video.
